stocks.headline: Down to 147.01 premarket (-5.4%) after Monday's Huang comeback bounce faded and AI selling spread through Asia.
stocks.why: Huang's return came with pressure from Trump and talk of a pardon. That turns a scandal into a political fight, with Congress and voters in both parties now looking at tech's ties to the White House. A second story matters more for the whole group: lenders are getting pickier about Big Tech bonds. If funding for the AI build-out gets harder, Nvidia's customers spend less, and that hits MU, AVGO, TSM, ARM, SMCI and CRWV hardest. The business itself is fine: sales are up 106%, forecasts are up 28% in 90 days, and the stock trades at 9x next year's profit, so the fall is about fear, not results.

long_term.reason: The business is the strongest in the group and cheap at 9x forward. But governance and political risk now sit on top of the AI spending worry, so this is not the moment to add size.

stocks.what_would_change_it: Upgrade to Add on dips if it holds 124.5 on any further selling while forecasts keep rising. Downgrade if big customers say they are cutting AI spending.
stocks.action: Hold your shares and don't buy the open. Add only if it climbs back above 150.5 after the first hour.

levels.means: above = yesterday's low is back and buyers are stepping in; below = the selling is still in control
above = the 52-week low holds as the floor; below = a new leg down, so stay out

stocks.if_then: If it trades below 124.5, then don't add, and wait for the selling to stop before buying anything in the AI group.

stocks.headline: 288.5 premarket (-4.2%): this is the buy zone below 288.79, sitting on the 52-week low of 288.98.
stocks.why: Broadcom is down because the whole AI group is down. Nothing has gone wrong at the company itself: sales are up 86% and speeding up, it has a 179.2B backlog, and it trades at 15.5x forward profit. The price has now reached the level where the long-term buy starts. The risk is timing. It reports around Dec 9, and the stock typically moves about 11% on report days, so a full position now carries that risk too. A clean break below the 52-week low would show the AI selling is not done, and that would weigh on TSM and ARM as well.

long_term.reason: It is in the buy zone below 288.79, with a backlog of 179.2B and fast-growing sales that the price has stopped paying for.

stocks.what_would_change_it: A weak outlook or a cut to the backlog at the Dec 9 report would end the buy case.
stocks.action: Don't buy the open. Buy a first third only if it trades back to 289.77 after the first hour, and keep the rest for after the Dec 9 report.

levels.means: above = it has reclaimed the 20-day low, so buy the first piece; below = it is still breaking down
above = the 52-week low holds; below = new lows, so stop buying
above = yesterday's low is back and the bounce is real; below = the rally is weak

stocks.if_then: If it closes the first hour below 288.98, then skip today's buy and wait for the Dec 9 report.

stocks.headline: 588.39 premarket (-6.6%) after an 11% drop yesterday, sitting just above the 20-day low of 585.25.
stocks.why: Micron is the highest-beta way to own AI spending, so every worry about AI debt and data-center funding hits it twice as hard as the market. The business is booming: sales are up 345%, the backlog is 134.0B, and it trades at 3x forward profit. That cheapness tells you the market expects memory prices to peak. The Dec 17 report is the real test. Until then the stock moves with the AI group, not with its own results.

long_term.reason: The earnings power is huge, but the stock is half its 52-week high and still falling. Let the Dec 17 report and the 585.25 floor show whether the cycle peak is priced in.

stocks.what_would_change_it: A strong Dec 17 report with the backlog intact while 585.25 holds would turn this into a buy.
stocks.action: Don't buy today. Treat a break of 585.25 as the signal that the AI selling has another leg.

levels.means: above = the 20-day low holds; below = no floor until much lower

stocks.if_then: If it holds 585.25 and climbs back above 622.22, then drop the avoid call and wait for Dec 17.
